errors.error_description: Used a unique case statement for the state machine without a default branch, leading to an unhandled state condition.
Introduced two continuous assignments driving the same wire net, causing multiple drivers on grant_bus.
Declared an internal signal (unused_toggle) that is never read or driven, making it an unused signal.
Assigned a 4-bit vector (req_i) to a 2-bit variable (prio_ptr) without explicit truncation or casting, causing width mismatch.
